name: Netlify
description: A web hosting and developer platform providing APIs for atomic deploys, form submissions, snippet injection, and site management.

evidence.claim: Netlify provides a REST-style API that uses JSON for serialization and OAuth 2 for authentication.
Personal access tokens (PATs) can be generated via the UI for manual/bearer authentication.
Netlify provides an official MCP server for connecting code agents.

notes: Netlify has robust REST APIs, personal access tokens (PATs), OAuth2, an official SDK, and even an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.
